title: Ines and the Confession
author: Odile Delacroix
blurb: Coral Dravenmoor, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
